body.name: First strict latent support pattern
body.construction: Let \(\mathcal B_0\) have binary observed nodes \(A,D,B\), one binary latent root \(H\), arrows \(H\to A\), \(H\to B\), \(A\to D\), \(A\to B\), and \(D\to B\), observed alphabets \(\Omega_A=\Omega_D=\Omega_B=\{0,1\}\), the qualitative functional declaration \(W=\{D\}\), and the single support literal \(P(A=1)=0\). Consider the two state-specific queries \(P_{A=0}(B=b)\) and \(P_{A=1}(B=b)\), for \(b\in\{0,1\}\).
